items.title: RT by @charliebilello: RT by @charliebilello: The 2-Year Treasury Rate of 4.56% is now 93 bps higher than the Fed Funds Rate (3.63%). This is the widest spread since November 2022. items.content:

items.title: RT by @charliebilello: RT by @charliebilello: 10 years ago: 30-yr mortgage rate was 3.4% & median existing home price in the US was $240k Today: 30-yr mortgage rate is 6.8% & median existing home price is $429k Result: $38k increase in down payment (assume 20% down) & 163% increase in monthly payment (from $851 to $2,237) Video:
items.content:
10 years ago: 30-yr mortgage rate was 3.4% & median existing home price in the US was $240k

Today: 30-yr mortgage rate is 6.8% & median existing home price is $429k

Result: $38k increase in down payment (assume 20% down) & 163% increase in monthly payment (from $851 to $2,237)

Video:  youtube.com/watch?v=TT9ajz9P… 
— Charlie Bilello (@charliebilello) Sep 10, 2026

items.title: RT by @charliebilello: RT by @charliebilello: At the start of the year, the bond market was pricing in 2 Fed rate CUTS. It's now pricing in 2 Fed rate HIKES. That's a 1% swing in expectations. The 2-Year Treasury yield entered the year at 3.48%. It ended the day at 4.56%. Video:
items.content:
At the start of the year, the bond market was pricing in 2 Fed rate CUTS.

It's now pricing in 2 Fed rate HIKES.

That's a 1% swing in expectations.

The 2-Year Treasury yield entered the year at 3.48%. It ended the day at 4.56%.

Video:  youtube.com/watch?v=9ROP49Ca… 
— Charlie Bilello (@charliebilello) Sep 10, 2026
